messages:
alex: Quick sync — pen-test PDF landed, flagging remediation that touches RBAC, audit logging, and KMS. Need a short QA checklist + evidence handoff for ops before we schedule a retest. Can owners ack and call out blockers? <@morgan> <@samir>

morgan: Ack. I'll take RBAC. Plan is: create least-priv service roles, apply via terraform PR, include IAM policy diffs in the PR description. Question: do we need a cross-account role change for the Dedicated accounts or just service principals?

samir: Depends on the findings. For KMS-related remediation I need to know if they want key rotation vs new key creation. Rotation is straightforward but we should ensure old ciphertext rewrap works. If we create a new key, we need a migration window.

priay: (typo: priya) I'll own QA acceptance. Proposed quick checklist: 1) Verify RBAC changes only grant listed actions, 2) Confirm audit logs show actor/resource for repro'd steps, 3) Check KMS decrypt access only to intended roles. Minimal evidence: terraform plan diff, cloud audit export snippet, and decrypt test log.

alex: Good. For audit logs — we need exact retention/query location. Ops, where do we pull exported logs for the retest evidence? <-- @elena

elena: Ops can export GCP/CloudTrail -> central logging bucket. I'll drop the GCS path once PR hits staging. For quick lookup use this jq filter against exported JSON lines:```jq 'select(.protoPayload.methodName|test("(Create|Update|Delete|Encrypt|Decrypt)")) | {time: .timestamp, actor: .protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, action: .protoPayload.methodName, resource: .resourceName}'```

samir: KMS note: if you're on AWS KMS, use:```bash
aws kms re_encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://data.enc --destination-key-id alias/new-key --destination-encryption-context '{"env":"staging"}'
```Test decrypt after re-encrypt. If GCP:```bash
gcloud kms keys versions list --key my-key --location global --keyring my-ring
```

morgan: For the RBAC terraform PR, I want this in the PR body: impacted principals, pre/post policy JSON, and a documented rollback plan (policy revert commit). Also include `audit: true` annotation in policy to make sure it's searchable.

priya: QA evidence template (I can paste to PR): - terraform-diff.txt - audit-sample.jsonl (3 entries with timestamps) - decrypt-test-output.txt (command + output) - acceptance.txt (pass/fail + notes). I can sign off when all 4 are attached.

eng-pen-test-bot: Pen-test report uploaded: https://internal-storage/reports/pt-2026-03-18.pdf (sha256: c3f4...) | Evidence bucket: gs://redwood-pen-test-evidence/staging/pt-2026-03-18/

alex: Perfect. Ops — propose a retest window Fri 2026-03-26 14:00-16:00 UTC. If that works, we'll freeze changes to staging between 12:00-16:30 UTC for stable environment. @elena can you confirm?

elena: Confirmed. I'll reserve the window and set a deploy freeze. Please tag PR with `retest-slot:2026-03-26T14:00Z`.

morgan: I'll open the terraform PR today and include the RBAC test harness. Linking here when ready.

samir: I'll prepare KMS migration docs and include the re-encrypt checklist. One blocker: we need access to the old key material for rewrap — @alex can you confirm access policy?

alex: I can grant temporary access via the emergency KMS role for the migration. Will do a least-priv grant and log it.

priay: One more QA ask — can we add a small repro script in the PR that performs the exact sequence from the pen-test steps so we can automate evidence capture? I can review the script.

morgan: Good idea. I'll add a `repro.sh` with the exact calls and sample outputs (sanitized).

alex: Great. Next actions: Morgan: RBAC PR + repro script. Samir: KMS migration doc. Priya: QA template & attach acceptance checklist. Elena: reserve retest window + export path. I'll coordinate the retest invite and stakeholders. :thumbsup:

elena: :thumbsup: noted and calendar invite will follow.

morgan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/482 (includes plan and rollback). Marking as `sec/rbac` and `retest-ready` once accepted.

priay: I reviewed the PR. Minor nit on a policy doc — commented. Once fixed I'll run the repro.sh and attach outputs here.

alex: Thanks all. We'll reconvene if any blocker pops. If not, aim for retest on 2026-03-26.

eng-pen-test-bot: Retest slot reserved and calendar event created for 2026-03-26T14:00Z. Evidence bucket ACLs updated to include `sec-team@redwood` for the window.
